name: Agent Skills
description: Install agent skills globally via npx skills (vercel-labs/skills). Ships a runtime sync script that uses git clone with gh auth fallback for private repos, creates a proper lock file for npx skills update, and per-agent symlinks. GitHub-agnostic — the devcontainer ensures gh is authed before sync runs.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of skill packages (GitHub repos) to install

agents.description: Comma-separated agent names to create symlinks for (e.g. 'devin,claude-code,codex'). Default '*' = all known agents
